subject: Agriculture
title: Fertigation
description: A micro-lesson that makes Fertigation usable.

hook.text: Why water fields and then spread fertilizer separately? Fertigation does both at once.

buildup.text: Dissolved nutrients are injected into irrigation water and delivered directly to plant roots through drip lines.

discovery.text: Plants absorb nutrients more efficiently in dissolved form. Less fertilizer is needed for the same yield.

twist.text: Over-fertigation contaminates groundwater. Precise dosing requires sensors and careful management.

climax.text: Modern fertigation systems adjust nutrient mixes automatically based on soil sensors and growth stage.

punchline.text: Feed the plant, not the field. Precision pays.

quiz.question: What is fertigation?
options: Injecting dissolved nutrients into irrigation water delivered to roots
